create_RunningRMS: create a RunningRMS module to track running root mean square statistics for a tensor of given size
update_RunningRMS: update a RunningRMS module with new tensor data to incrementally compute mean square statistics
create_RunningMoments: create a RunningMoments module to track running mean and variance using Welford's online algorithm
update_RunningMoments: update a RunningMoments module with new tensor data to incrementally compute mean and variance
create_RunningTDError: create a RunningTDError module to estimate running TD error variance from gamma, reward, and advantage tensors
